nina: Heads-up: Docusaurus build is erroring on fragments that point to headings immediately after fenced code blocks. Example failing link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk#python-quickstart carlos: Can you paste a minimal repro? nina: Snippet from /sdk/quickstart.md: ```markdown ```bash pip install redwood-sdk ``` ### Python quickstart Run the snippet above to install. ``` preeti: I can reproduce locally. The generated id becomes `python-quickstart-1` instead of `python-quickstart`. It looks like the slugifier treats the code fence as an invisible heading marker in some cases. sam: CI linkcheck output: ``` [linkcheck] ERROR: Fragment not found: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk#python-quickstart (status: 200) [docusaurus] ERROR in plugin-content-docs: anchor not found for marker \"#python-quickstart\" ``` carlos: Short-term fix options: 1) add an explicit HTML anchor before the heading, 2) change the heading text to include an explicit slug with {#python-quickstart} if our parser supports it, or 3) update every incoming link to the deduped slug. I prefer (1) because it's lowest risk. nina: Example quick-fix I pushed to branch fix/codeblock-heading-anchor: ```html 
pip install redwood-sdk
### Python quickstart ``` This mirrors the previous anchor behaviour without changing the heading. preeti: Docs-bot created a preview: https://deploy-preview-1199--staging.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/quickstart (build 1199) :white_check_mark: Linkcheck now passes for that page. sam: We should also add a short note to docs/migration/MDX-AND-FENCES.md: \"headings that follow fenced code blocks may receive dedupe suffixes; add explicit anchors or use explicit slug syntax when linking externally.\" carlos: I'll follow up with a ticket to adjust the slugify plugin for consistent behaviour across mkdocs/docusaurus. Also adding a regression test to docs CI to search for pattern `fenced-block -> heading` and verify the fragment exists. nina: Thanks. After merge, let's run a full site linkcheck and triage remaining pages. Prefer to keep quick-fix patches small and well-documented in the migration note. docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#3145 — fix: add explicit anchors after code fences for stable fragments (assigns: carlos, reviewers: preeti, sam)
